aggregation_disclaimer: Trade-flow records are national/regional aggregates. They carry no firm-level revenue, R&D or market-share attribution. Procurement records name a recipient as published by the awarding body; they do not identify the manufacturer of any device unless the award text names a concrete device or model.

aggregation_method: Per HS4: one OData $apply=filter(...)/groupby((MonthId,FlowTypeId),aggregate(Value with sum as TotalValue)) call over all CN8 children of that HS4; then months are summed to years and EU + non-EU flows are added per direction. No row-level OTS dump was downloaded.
coverage_limits: OTS has no world-total row: the total is our sum, so it inherits any suppression in the underlying cells.
Values are in GBP and are NOT deflated or converted.
FlowType 1/2 are EU flows, 3/4 non-EU: an import total is 1+3 and an export total is 2+4. Reading flow 1 as 'imports' understates UK imports by the non-EU share.
The UK left the EU customs union in 2021, so the EU/non-EU split is not stable across the 2015-2025 window.
